_comment: sim-preplace-sweep-cage-clearance-v1: clear the carried PRE-PLACE leg-2 shoulder_pan sweep of the Rollwagen cart cage, and refuse an intersecting sweep BY NAME before motion. coldwin70 CPU reconstruction (nav-trace park pose + the executed CARTON_TICK joints, scripts/check_preplace_sweep_clearance.py): the wrist-first leg-2 EXTENDS the arm to the standoff shape (elbow 1.0 -> 1.4788, lift -2.27 -> -1.4856) BEFORE sweeping shoulder_pan 1.2678 -> -0.4053, so leg-2 rotates the already-extended, low gripper HOUSING on an arc that rakes /Rollwagen/chassis/post_2 (the +x mouth post) and the upper side-wall bar side_0_horizontal_6 (z 1.064-1.076) at shoulder_pan ~ 0.20 rad -- exactly where the executed pan FROZE (0.2012) with a 1632.7 N*m effort spike (cw69 SEAL_DIAG hit_bodies=['/Rollwagen/chassis/post_2'] min_gap_mm 0.0 is the same contact). It is the ARM (the gripper end-effector housing, an UNFILTERED robot link), NOT the carton: the carton is cage-FILTERED (cage_collision: filtered keeps deck/shelf/drawbar), so the carton CANNOT be the sim contact -- only an unfiltered robot link can. The fix (PAN-FIRST reorder) sweeps shoulder_pan to the standoff while the arm stays TUCKED at the compact carry shape, THEN extends over the open deck: CPU cage clearance +252 mm (raking bodies) vs -48 mm. Merge the HOST keys into the mission runtime-config HOST block (read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). Absent/false => wrist-first (byte-identical).
_preplace_pan_first_note: HOST bool (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key). Requires preplace_wrist_first (it reuses that two-leg machinery, inverted). When BOTH are true the controller runs preplace_sequence.pan_first_subgoals: leg 1 sweeps shoulder_pan to the standoff while the wrists+lift+elbow HOLD at the carry shape (console: PREPLACE_PAN_FIRST leg 1 ...), then leg 2 extends the wrists/lift/elbow to the standoff. The carton is re-leveled in leg 2's extend by the existing world-level leveller; the 2.0 deg tilt bound is UNCHANGED. This leaves the station base lock (PR 365, sim-station-lock-from-preplace-v1) and the firm wrist hold (PR 359, sim-preplace-wrist2-hold-v1) fully compatible -- the reorder only changes WHICH joint moves first, not the gains/locks.
_cage_clearance_gate: OPT-IN refuse-by-name gate (defense-in-depth beside the reorder). The capability is place_clearance.preplace_cage_clearance_provider(urdf_path, xrdf_path, cart_pose, margin=0.0) -> callable(waypoints)->reject|None, injected into the controller as controller._preplace_cage_clearance by the boot/integration layer (where the live coupled cart-body -> ur_base_link pose + the host XRDF are available). When set, _issue_gated_preplace_approach refuses an INTERSECTING leg-2 sweep by name before motion: 'PREPLACE_SWEEP_CLEARANCE prim=post_2 min_clearance=-48.0mm ...', instead of the blind ~1632 N*m jam + opaque 120 s PHASE_CONVERGENCE. None (default) => inert => byte-identical. The gate checks the cuMotion ARM SPHERE model (world_obstacles.arm_spheres_world) -- the real robot-link collision set incl. the gripper housing -- against the CAGE bodies (posts + side/back bars; place_clearance.cage_body_names), NOT the pad-only honest sweep (which reads +11 mm clear where the housing penetrates post_2 by 48 mm). Refuse margin DEFAULT 0.0 (an actually PENETRATING sweep): the CPU geometry carries a documented ~40-90 mm offset from the sim colliders, so only a clear negative reading is a certain strike, and the pre-place standoff itself sits an inherent +4.2 mm from the FAR side wall (within that noise) -- a positive margin would block even a clearing path. The >= 0.04 m target is the DESIGN GOAL the reorder meets on the raking bodies (+252 mm), asserted by scripts/check_preplace_sweep_clearance.py.
_compatibility: Compatible with and intended to run ALONGSIDE: preplace_wrist_first (required), the station base lock from pre-place (sim-station-lock-from-preplace-v1, PR 365), the firm pre-place wrist_2 hold (sim-preplace-wrist2-hold-v1, PR 359), the contact-gated place-descent weld release (PR 363), and the centred place-between-posts nominal (PR 364). The reorder changes only the leg ordering of the carried preplace approach; it does not touch the base lock, the wrist gains, the weld release, the place target, or the 2.0 deg tilt bound.
_requires: preplace_wrist_first=true must be set (the pan-first reorder has no effect without it). Register preplace_pan_first in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key). The HOST block should already carry the station-hold keys (station_pitch_hold / station_hold_pitch_deg / station_hold_roll_deg) that mirror the RUNTIME chassis_station_pitch_hold_* so the carton levels in the WORLD frame across both legs.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the coldwin70 collect place-on-cart capstone chain under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB respected; whispr ~2.2 GB), with this HOST block merged (preplace_wrist_first + preplace_pan_first true, PR 359 + PR 365 ON). Expected PASS: HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG shows preplace_pan_first=true; the console logs 'PREPLACE_PAN_FIRST leg 1: sweeping shoulder_pan to the standoff while the arm holds the tucked carry shape'; the pan sweep completes to the standoff with NO STATION_FULL_BRAKE_ABORT / 1632 N*m effort spike and NO PHASE_CONVERGENCE on shoulder_pan; the CARTON_TICK tilt stays <= 2.0 deg through both legs; the place descent + contact-gated release complete. If the pre-place standoff's inherent +4.2 mm far-wall (side_1_horizontal_6) clearance proves too tight on GPU, the follow-up is to lift/centre the standoff (a place-target geometry change, out of this lane's scope -- see data/sim-preplace-sweep-cage-clearance-v1/report.md).
